article.headline: Jaylen Wysinger scores 23 to lead Texas Southern over Alabama State 80-69
article.description: — Jaylen Wysinger's 23 points helped Texas Southern defeat Alabama State 80-69 on Monday night, upping the Tigers' win streak to six.
article.linkText: Jaylen Wysinger scores 23 to lead Texas Southern over Alabama State 80-69
article.story: MONTGOMERY, Ala. -- — Jaylen Wysinger's 23 points helped Texas Southern defeat Alabama State 80-69 on Monday night, upping the Tigers' win streak to six. Wysinger added nine rebounds for the Tigers (9-11, 6-1 Southwestern Athletic Conference). Kavion McClain hit four 3-pointers and scored 20. Kolby Granger shot 5 of 7 from the field and 6 of 6 from the free-throw line to finish with 16 points, while adding eight rebounds. The Hornets (8-12, 4-3) were led by Antonio Madlock, who recorded 18 points, 13 rebounds and five assists. CJ Hines added 16 points and seven rebounds. Micah Octave totaled eight points and six steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
